title: PTR 2.57.1.98644 — Heroes of the Storm PTR Patch Notes - November 9, 2026, amended by Probius
subtitle: from 2.57.0.98348

lines: Blizzard's official notes with Probius additions. Green text marks changes found in the game data that the official notes do not mention. Green means additional, not a buff.

Our next Heroes of the Storm patch has just hit the Public Test Realm and will be available for playtesting. As always, if you encounter any bugs during your PTR play sessions, please stop by the PTR Bug Report forum to let us know about your experiences.
